name: harness
description: A provider-neutral software-delivery harness with executable agent graphs, bounded context, durable memory, behavioral evals, trusted tool policy, and human gates.

interface.shortDescription: Executable agent graphs, durable memory, evals, and human gates.
interface.longDescription: Harness routes each task to quick, standard, or full delivery; compiles bounded provenance-rich context; validates provider-neutral loop and task-graph contracts; can execute a reviewed role graph through a capability-bounded adapter with model profiles, exact tool scopes, durable action-bound approvals, cancellation, crash guards, and a hash-chained trace; preserves scoped memory; defends research and tool output from prompt injection; and applies behavioral evals, evidence-based QA, and human gates. Named models and optional tools remain reviewed backend mappings rather than hard dependencies.
capabilities: Bounded Goal, Scheduled, and Proactive Loop Contracts
Durable Loop Delivery, Lease, Evidence, and Usage Receipts
Behavioral Full and Ablation Evaluation Matrix
Isolated Concurrent Writers and Bounded Long Runs
Conditional Business Analysis and Requirement Baselines
defaultPrompt: Use Harness to choose the smallest safe workflow and implement this request.
Use Harness standard to plan, build, test, and hand off this feature.
Use Harness full to investigate and fix this production-risk bug.

Use Harness Loop Engineering for this repeated task: validate one observable goal, deterministic verifiers, fixed run and resource budgets, rollback, evidence, overlap controls, and human gates before starting.

Use Harness Loop Engineering with the local supervisor ledger: bind the active contract and accepted Git baseline, deduplicate deliveries, lease one iteration, record trusted verifier and usage receipts, and stop fail-closed.
Use Harness standard with Graph Engineering for this feature: split only independent jobs, validate the task graph, merge through one owner, and gate consequential effects.
Use Harness Graph Engineering with the local receipt ledger for this session-resilient run: bind the exact baseline, claim bounded nodes, verify artifacts and write scopes, and resume fail-closed.
Use Harness full for this bounded long-running task: isolate the workspace, fix the verification contract and budgets, emit progress receipts, and do not push, merge, or deploy without approval.
Use Harness full with adaptive model routing: reasoning for plan and deep review, balanced for implementation, and fast only for bounded low-risk shards.
Use Harness review to inspect the current changes without modifying them.
Use Harness resume to continue the validated active project run.
Use Harness init to add portable project memory and Codex, Claude, and Gemini adapters without overwriting existing instructions.
Preview and migrate this legacy Harness project without losing its existing memory or instructions.
